name: scroller
need: Let a wide strip scroll sideways with edge fades, and float a jump pill in a log

--ds-scroll-fade.description: the length of the edge fades of `.ds-scroll-x`, the table wrappers and the cut edges of menus, combobox lists and drawer lists (2.1); `0px` turns every fade off

physical..ds-scroll-x: -webkit-mask-image: gradient direction: the edge fades follow the sideways scroll
physical..ds-scroll-x: mask-image: gradient direction: the edge fades follow the sideways scroll
